purpose.en: Moves your ankle and loosens up your lower leg.

text.zh: 胯和膝盖不动，脚尖先绷直再勾起来
text.en: Hip and knee stay still, point your toes, then pull them up

text.zh: 一只手轻扶椅子，这只脚悬空。
text.en: One hand resting on a chair, this foot off the floor.

text.zh: 绷一下再勾一下算 1 下，慢慢做别憋气。
text.en: One point and one pull counts as one. Go slow and keep breathing.

commonErrors.en: Going so fast your whole leg swings.

cautions.zh: 扶稳椅背单腿站，小腿抽筋就放下脚歇歇
cautions.en: Hold the chair while on one leg. If your calf cramps, put the foot down and rest.
